notifications.title: The weekly loop can't judge this channel at one Short a day
notifications.detail: This channel has 2 Shorts made (17 and 18 Nov), none with 48 h data. The weekly loop needs 8 Shorts a side (16 in all) within 7 days, extended once to 14, so at about one Short a day no test can ever reach a verdict. The improver has not started this channel's first challenger yet so its first Shorts all follow the champion recipe.
notifications.fix: 1. Either raise this channel's Shorts a day to 2-3 on the Channels page, or 2. accept that its first challenger will end 'abandon' at 14 days, or 3. tell the improver (a dashboard note) to start the first challenger anyway. Nothing breaks if you do nothing: the channel keeps making champion Shorts.
